paper_title: Dark matter detection using nuclear magnetization in magnet with hyperfine interaction
coupling_convention: g_app, dimensionless axion-proton coupling as plotted
notes: Projection paper for axion/dark-photon detection using MnCO3 canted antiferromagnet with hyperfine interaction. The nuclear spin is proton-dominated, so it is sensitive to axion-proton coupling gapp (not neutron). Main text states axion of mass ~1e-6 eV with gapp >~ 1e-11 could be probed via nuclear-dominated mode. Also sensitive to gaee (~1e-14 at ~1e-6 eV) and dark photon epsilon. Detailed sensitivity curves are in Figs 7-9 but numerical values not tabulated in provided text; only a single representative point extractable. dm_density = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (Eq. 2.12). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 18)) | Vision: Figure 7 shows two narrow projected sensitivity regions (V-shapes) for g_app: green nuclear-dominated mode near 2e-6 eV reaching down to ~1e-11, and red/orange electron-dominated mode near 2e-4 eV reaching down to ~6e-9. These are projected sensitivities, not exclusions. Gray region above ~5e-10 is SN1987A/NS cooling astrophysical constraint. KSVZ/DFSZ diagonal blue band shown for reference. | Calibration: No calibration needed
